summary: End-to-end UI-click testing of DiaGyn Staff Portal Schedule tab (Block Dates/Slots) and the patient-facing /diagyn calendar reflection. Tested all three scenarios (A: no-conflict block, B: conflict + override cancel-and-block, C: session block partial-day) via real browser clicks on mobile viewport (390x844). ALL three scenarios PASSED with zero UI bugs. No console errors, no failed API calls, no double-submission risk (override button correctly toggles to `disabled` mid-request via `submitting` state, confirmed programmatically). The reported user complaint 'appointments aren't being cancelled even after blocking dates / slots still open' could NOT be reproduced on the preview environment.

action_items: No code changes required. The block/override + calendar-reflection flow is working correctly end-to-end on the preview environment.

Most likely root cause of user report: user is testing on production nevikacura.com which lacks the schedule.py / DoctorDetailModal deploy, OR user is not clicking the 'Cancel Appointments & Block' override button when the red conflict card appears (UX confusion -- they may think the block silently failed because the initial 'Block Date' click returns success:false without a toast).

MINOR UX SUGGESTION (optional, not a bug): When the initial block-date/block-session POST returns {conflict:true} the code silently sets state and returns without any toast. If the conflict card is scrolled below the fold on small screens, the staff might not realize they need to click override. Consider adding `toast.warning('Conflict detected -- review appointments and choose action')` alongside setConflict() so users get an auditory cue that the click did register.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffScheduleView.jsx submitBlockDate/submitBlockSession: cleanly guard with `submitting` boolean; force_override flows are correct; loadBlocks re-fetch after success is correct.
DoctorDetailModal.jsx: fetches /api/doctors/blocked-dates on doctor+clinic select; isDoctorAvailable correctly disables full-day blocks; slot fetch correctly filters out session windows.
Backend schedule.py conflict payload shape ({conflict, patients:[{name,time,phone,booking_id}], message}) exactly matches what the frontend consumes. No shape mismatch.

Response for conflict returns HTTP 200 (not 4xx) which is intentional so frontend can render the warning without a toast.error, but this is easy to misinterpret as success -- consider adding an in-JSON `severity:'warning'` hint or a toast on the frontend for the initial conflict return.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all 3 endpoint flows verified via real browser)

rca of the issue: No reproducible UI bug on preview. Verified via real browser clicks: (1) conflict warning card appears with correct patient info, (2) override button is disabled during submit preventing double-clicks, (3) override POST sends force_override:true correctly, (4) appointment status becomes 'Cancelled' in MongoDB, (5) date appears in blocked list without reload, (6) patient-facing /diagyn calendar disables the blocked date and slot picker filters out blocked session windows correctly. Most probable root cause of the recurring user report is either (a) user testing production (which has NOT been deployed), or (b) UX confusion where staff doesn't see/click the red 'Cancel Appointments & Block' override button when the conflict warning card is scrolled below the fold on their device.
